decision_conditions:
<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;">The
proposal harms the character and appearance of the Conservation Area through
the loss of greenery, undermining its distinctive Metroland character and
resulting in a harder, more urban streetscene.&nbsp;The
application fails to acknowledge this harm or provide the clear and convincing
justification required by the NPPF, and no public benefits have been
demonstrated to outweigh the harm to the designated heritage asset.</p><p>



</p><p class="MsoListParagraph" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;">In addition, insufficient
information has been submitted, including details of the front boundary
treatment, and works appear to have commenced without justification. The
proposal is therefore contrary to National
Planning Policy Framework (2024), The London Plan (2021) policy D3 and The Harrow
local Plan policy GR1 and HE1,&nbsp; and the Tookes Green Conservation Area Appraisal and Management Strategy<span style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">&nbsp;</span></p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;">The proposed development is unacceptable on
flood risk and drainage grounds. The site lies within areas of high and medium
risk of surface water flooding and Flood Zones 2 and 3 for fluvial flooding.<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoListParagraphCxSpLast" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;">The submitted Flood Risk Assessment is outdated and relates to a
different proposal, and is therefore insufficient to demonstrate the
development would be safe or would not increase flood risk elsewhere. In
addition, insufficient details have been provided regarding levels, permeable
paving, and compensatory flood storage, particularly given the likely raising
of ground levels.<o:p></o:p></p><p>



</p><p class="MsoListParagraph" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;">In the absence of adequate, up-to-date information, the proposal
fails to demonstrate compliance with National Planning Policy Framework (2024),
The London Plan (2021) policy SI12 and S113 and The Harrow local Plan policy
CN3 and CN4<span style="font-size:12.0pt;font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif;
mso-fareast-font-family:&quot;Times New Roman&quot;;mso-bidi-font-family:&quot;Times New Roman&quot;"><o:p></o:p></span></p>
description: Demolition of the existing boundary treatment at the front, along with the flower pods, and proposal of the dwarf wall at the front, along the north west side and the fence on the south east side, proposal of the front steps and change of the front entrance door
